prompt: A single children's-book style illustration of a small golden-brown bear cub mascot, drawn in soft painterly gouache with visible paper-grain texture, shown from the chest up as if peeking over an edge with both front paws gripping that edge. The bear wears a navy blue baseball cap turned forward with a golden-yellow letter B on the front, and slim black over-ear headphones with a thin boom microphone. Warm ochre and caramel fur with soft shading, small rounded ears, dark navy eyes with a single white highlight, a dark navy nose, and a small open friendly smile. CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS: Completely transparent background, no backdrop, band, panel, card or paper sheet behind the character. No text, letters, words, handwriting, captions or speech bubbles anywhere except the single letter B on the cap. No interface elements: no tabs, folder shapes, buttons, icons, scales of justice, borders, frames or drop shadow. Nothing for the bear to lean on: the paws grip an invisible edge, cropped flat at the bottom of the frame; do not draw the ledge itself. The character fills the frame edge to edge with no margin. Palette: fur #c8873c and #a5661f, cap #1b3f7a with #e8b73a lettering, headphones near-black #2b2b30, eyes and nose #0a2457.
postprocess:
Regenerated to replace an earlier plate that had baked the interface chrome into the raster — the hacker and judge tab fields, the desk background, a scales icon duplicating the live lucide <Scale>, and the handwritten line 'Same you. More impact.' That version forced the judge tab to render transparent with its icon hidden, and its baked blue did not match the tab's #2a6ac6.

This render honoured the brief for content — correct peek pose, no text beyond the cap's B, no chrome, no ledge — but did not honour it for alpha: gpt-image-2 returned an opaque RGB image that *depicts* transparency as a painted grey-and-white checkerboard rather than writing an alpha channel. Repaired with ImageMagick: keyed the checker tones globally at 6% fuzz, closed the pinholes that opened in the eye highlights (-morphology Close Disk:5), eroded the alpha edge by 2px to shave the checker's anti-aliased halo, trimmed to the artwork, and resized to 420x336 RGBA — the plate renders at 150px CSS, so 420px keeps headroom for a 2x display without carrying bulk. 2.7MB -> 236KB.

The judge tab now draws its own paper field, border, shadow and icon in CSS; this plate contributes only the mascot.
